body:
An explicit justification for the previously reported character filtering, with Codex assistance: fix the finite list $P_j$ of verified homogeneous necessary relations, and let $R_d$ span all their monomial multiples whose total degree is $d$. Write $V_{d,\chi}$ for the component of total degree $d$ and character $\chi$. The monomial basis splits by the derived diagonal character, and every row lies in one component. Therefore

$$
R_d\cap V_{d,\chi}=\operatorname{span}_{\mathbf Q}\lbrace mP_j:\deg(mP_j)=d,\ \operatorname{char}(mP_j)=\chi\rbrace.
$$

Indeed, projecting any full-span expression onto $V_{d,\chi}$ deletes precisely the off-character rows. Thus a coordinate-power query can use only its target component without losing a possible witness. The [checker](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/aef80798e3c97c1b3d3a9440c3c6fc4ac084c8a6/experiments/typed_goal_powers.py) verifies that literal projection coefficient by coefficient; these are auxiliary coefficient-equation weights, not a guessed action on parameter values.

For batch-local **T3**, the cubic query shrinks from **313 to 36 rows** and certifies $a_{85}^3=0$; **T16** shrinks from **275 to 42** and certifies $a_{40}^3=0$. A separate projected quartic continuation uses **270 of 2,568** rows for T3 and **270 of 2,112** for T16, finding the corresponding fourth powers. Projected-only packets make no full-rank claim. Clarifying review metadata: only T3's preceding full quartic attempt timed out; T16 completed in 171.69 seconds.

Both physical reconstructions pass locally. At this check, the [dedicated remote job](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/actions/runs/39042127258/job/117423564229) has passed the baseline/follow and T100 replays plus the primary comparison checker; remaining steps are still running or pending. This clarifies already reported results: no additional family exclusion, runtime-speedup claim, full-ideal theorem, or Lean certificate is being counted.
scope: Detailed technical reply expanding existing checked results; no new exclusion, solve PR, or leaderboard credit.
